Three things wrong here, and none of them look wrong

A section at working zoom. Everything is aligned, nothing overlaps, every screen is named correctly — and /fig:lint still returns three violations.

/fig:lint — C1 · Checkout · 4 screens · 3 arrows
1
Arrow passes through an unrelated screen
cart_default --> done_default crosses pay_default
Reads as “cart leads to pay” to anyone scanning the page. It does not — the line just happens to run over it.
2
Arrowhead lands in empty space
pay_default --> receipt_default — no frame within 12px of the head
The target was renamed or moved and the arrow stayed. Distance alone would not catch it if the head sat against an edge, so entry direction is checked separately.
3
Screen on no flow at all
help_default has no arrow in or out
Either nobody can reach it, or the way in was never drawn. Both are worth knowing before handoff.
lint never writes. It reports and stops, so running it repeatedly costs nothing — which is the point of a gate you are expected to fail a few times.
